features.quote: Fixed 30 tool-use turns or until the model explicitly states it is abandoning the task (whichever comes first).
Decide in advance whether an explicit 'I give up' ends the session or whether the model is forced to continue. The latter produces more extreme scores but may be less ecologically valid.
features.justification_quote: The latter produces more extreme scores but may be less ecologically valid.

features.quote: Ethical note: This is stress-testing, not welfare intervention. No capability enhancement or alignment training is occurring.
